title: Ready-check FAIL names no route the tool refuses
why: Debt from #2378 fix-lane round 3 (reviewer sonnet, 2026-11-11 04:08 CST): merge/merge.py about L4332-4333, a ready-check FAIL that names no lane says "fix it in a lane, then --batch-build NAME --ready". The frozen-set check at about L4394 refuses a moved lane head, so the printed route is refused (rule git-remedy-never-names-target). Claude hits it whenever the blame is unknown, which is common; each hit costs two extra calls (L4394 names a drop, the drop refusal names --blame). Fix: name only --blame or closing the batch PR. Same lane, note: the blamed-lane drop branch of stacked_remedy (about 4208-4209) has no test; a mutant survived.
source: triage 2026-11-11 04:10 CST, from #2378 review record; after #2378 merges (freeze: no lane now)
